short: ImageNet transfer on MEG scalograms (M03) and the learned sensor projection (M06) are standard; the ablation is new; rest and reading-order confounds limit the binary tasks (M12).
position: The paper [@jhilal2026imagenet] fine-tunes ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-18 and ViT-Tiny on MEG scalograms mixed by a learned three-map sensor projection (M03, M06). M03 is standard: ImageNet-pretrained CNNs on MEG Morlet scalograms of imagined phrases were used earlier [@dash2020meg], and a frozen ImageNet ResNet50 on imagined-speech EEG [@panachakel2021tl]; the new evidence is an ablation over 21 participants with leave-one-subject-out testing. M06 is standard: the learned projection is compared only with PCA-3, not with the earlier sensor mosaic [@dash2020meg]. M12 is standard, with permutation tests against chance, but the binary tasks contrast imagery with rest and with silent reading that always precedes it, and no articulatory EMG is recorded, unlike [@orpella2022imagery].
